newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Medco unit to trade in the forex market.
newsitem.headline: Medco unit to trade in the forex market.

text.p: The Philippine Central Bank said on Saturday it has granted a licence to the Export and Industry Bank to trade in the local foreign exchange market.
Central Bank governor Gabriel Singson said in a statement the bank has been granted a licence to operate an expanded foreign currency deposit unit.
The bank may also accept foreign currency deposits and trust accounts, deposit with foreign banks abroad and grant loans, and borrow and invest in foreign currency denominated instruments.
The Export and Industry Bank can also issue letters of credit for a non-resident importer in favour of a non-resident exporter.
The bank is 70 percent owned by the Philippine Exporters Confederation Inc and 30 percent by MEDCO Holdings, which is in turn controlled by the Lippo Bank of Indonesia.
